manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Shows the motion of a vertically tossed ball and vectors for velocity and acceleration.
manifest.description: A ball moves vertically on a fixed height scale. A motion vector shortens on the way up, disappears at the top, and points down on the way down, while a constant downward gravity vector persists.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
